clue.text: Assembled online info with evil intent, first rejecting a little

indicators.note: first tells us the turned-round piece comes at the front, before the other part
rejecting means turning back, so the phrase for a little is read the other way round

parts.note: a little is 'a tad'
base means low and immoral, as in base motives

explanation.surface: Someone gathers data online for wicked ends, having first turned down a small share.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a little' gives A TAD; 'rejecting' turns it to DATA, and 'first' puts it ahead of BASE.
explanation.definitionFit: A database is a structured collection of information stored on a computer and searched online.

clue.text: Tropical legume cook rarely uses

indicators.note: the phrase cook rarely uses these letters within it, so the word sits inside those two words

explanation.surface: A tropical bean that hardly ever appears in a chef's kitchen.
explanation.definitionFit: Okra is the edible green pod of a tropical plant, treated as a vegetable much like beans.

clue.text: One fetching and carrying timber from the ark

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a variant spelling of gofer, a dogsbody who runs errands
second meaning: in Genesis Noah built the ark of ... wood

explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures an animal bringing wood from Noah's ark; the two halves are separate meanings, an errand-runner and the Biblical timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Gopher is an accepted spelling of gofer, an errand-runner, and gopher wood is the timber named in the Bible for Noah's vessel.

clue.text: Walking slowly after a girl may be taking a risk

indicators.note: after places the walking piece behind the girl's letter

parts.note: G is the standard abbreviation for girl
ambling means walking at a leisurely pace

explanation.surface: Strolling along behind a young woman could be a risky business.
explanation.definitionFit: Gambling is betting or chancing something on an uncertain outcome.

clue.text: Communist country bridge player's declared vocation

parts.note: North is one of the four players at bridge

indicators.note: declared means spoken out, so the word for vocation is given as it sounds

parts.note: a vocation is a career

explanation.surface: A card player announcing a calling in a communist state.
explanation.walkthrough: KOREA is pronounced much like CAREER in a British accent.
explanation.definitionFit: North Korea is a one-party state run on communist lines.

clue.text: Showing no compassion at any time in Kent?

indicators.note: in places the word for at any time inside the region's abbreviation

parts.note: Kent is a county in the south-east of England, abbreviated SE
ever means at any time

explanation.surface: A question about whether anyone in Kent is ever pitiless.
explanation.definitionFit: Severe treatment is harsh and unsparing, without mercy.

clue.text: Clandestine second party serving men

parts.note: to second a motion is to back it
a do is a party
OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers

explanation.surface: A secret second celebration with servicemen in attendance.
explanation.definitionFit: A back-door arrangement is secret and underhand, done out of sight.

clue.text: A slowing down in network is no common occurrence?

indicators.note: in places the slowing piece inside the network's abbreviation

parts.note: RY is short for railway, a rail network
rit, short for ritardando, is the musical marking for slowing down

explanation.surface: A query whether a slow connection on the network is unusual.
explanation.walkthrough: RIT (ritardando) is the music term for slowing down.
explanation.definitionFit: A rarity is something uncommon that seldom happens or is found.

clue.text: A scan screening heart of Moroccan flyer

indicators.note: screening means hiding behind, so the scan word surrounds the central letters

parts.note: to vet is to examine or scan

indicators.note: heart of means the middle letters of the word

parts.note: its middle two letters are OC

explanation.surface: A scan reveals the core of a bird from Morocco.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocet is a wading bird with an upturned bill, so it is a flying creature.

clue.text: Exit speech from Atlantean, with the odd omission

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters are dropped, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: A departure speech by someone from Atlantis, missing an odd bit.
explanation.definitionFit: Ta-ta is a casual farewell, the remark made when leaving.

clue.text: Being realistic, cold wader left river

parts.note: a hard frost is a cold one

indicators.note: left means departed, so the river's letter goes out of the bird

parts.note: the bittern is a wading marsh bird
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A cold wading bird has left the river, a matter-of-fact observation.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard-bitten people are tough and unsentimental, seeing the world without illusions.

clue.text: Emperor, China's last, is hosted by king and queen

indicators.note: being hosted means being taken in, so these pieces go within the royal pair

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
ER is Elizabeth Regina

indicators.note: last means the final letter

parts.note: its final letter is A

explanation.surface: An Asian emperor entertained by a royal couple.
explanation.definitionFit: Kaiser was the title of the German and Austrian emperors.

clue.text: Dodgy South American spiritual, one convicts originally introduced

parts.note: S is the compass abbreviation for south
US means American

indicators.note: introduced means brought inside, so the pair goes into the devout word

parts.note: pious means devout or spiritual
I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: originally points to the first letter

parts.note: first letter of convicts

explanation.surface: A shady, devout South American is brought into a penal colony.
explanation.definitionFit: Something dodgy arouses suspicion; suspicious here means questionable rather than distrustful.

clue.text: Solidly built deep sink

parts.note: thick can mean deep, as in a thick layer
the sun sets when it sinks

explanation.surface: A sturdily constructed deep kitchen sink.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sink' looks like a noun in the surface but works as a verb, as the sun sinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A thickset person is stocky and heavily built.

clue.text: Bogus leading lady once remained unknown

parts.note: ER is the late Queen Elizabeth, once the country's first lady
sat means remained seated
Z is one of the letters used for an unknown quantity in algebra

explanation.surface: A former leading actress stayed anonymous, a fake.
explanation.definitionFit: Ersatz describes an inferior imitation or substitute, so something not genuine.

clue.text: Crossing fen, got an outlandish form of transport

indicators.note: crossing means stretching across, so the rearranged letters straddle the marsh word
outlandish means strange, so the letters are rearranged oddly

parts.note: a fen is a bog

explanation.surface: Someone crossing marshland reached it by a weird vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outlandish' turns GOT AN into TO GAN, which goes around BOG.
explanation.definitionFit: A toboggan is a sledge used to slide down snowy slopes, a way of travelling.

clue.text: Places formerly selling gold-lined ranges

indicators.note: lined means having a lining inside, so the gold letters go within the cookers

parts.note: Agas are a British brand of range cooker
OR is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Showrooms that once sold cookers trimmed with gold.
explanation.walkthrough: An Aga is a heavy cast-iron kitchen range popular in British country homes.
explanation.definitionFit: An agora was the marketplace of an ancient Greek city, where goods were traded.

clue.text: Experienced editor supporting main issue

indicators.note: in a down answer, supporting means placed underneath the other pieces

parts.note: the main is an old word for the open sea
issue means offspring, such as a son

explanation.surface: A veteran editor backs the leading story.
explanation.definitionFit: A seasoned person is practised and hardened by long experience.

clue.text: Cut top of oak, cracking little wood

indicators.note: cracking means breaking into, so the letter goes inside the wood

parts.note: a grove is a small wood

indicators.note: in a down clue the top is the first letter

parts.note: first letter of oak

explanation.surface: Someone lops the top off an oak, splitting a small wood.
explanation.definitionFit: A groove is a long narrow cut or channel in a surface.

clue.text: Having read abridged bible, sadly one strays from the text

indicators.note: sadly means badly, so the letters are scrambled
abridged means shortened, so the last letter is cut

explanation.surface: After reading a shortened Bible, a sorrowful reader departs from scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abridged' cuts BIBLE to BIBL; 'sadly' mixes READ and BIBL together.
explanation.definitionFit: An ad-libber improvises, speaking off-script instead of following a prepared text.

clue.text: Provision for light sleeper?

parts.note: a light sleeper normally wakes easily; read here as someone who sleeps in the light of day

explanation.walkthrough: 'light sleeper' suggests an easily woken person; here it means one who naps while it is light.
explanation.definitionFit: A daybed is a couch for resting or napping during daylight hours.

clue.text: God made man run after motorists, collecting tax

indicators.note: after places the run letter behind the motorists
collecting means gathering inside, so the tax goes into the motorists

parts.note: the AA is the Automobile Association, a British motorists' organisation
VAT is value added tax
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A deity in human form flees motorists while gathering tax.
explanation.definitionFit: An avatar in Hinduism is a deity descended to earth in bodily form, an incarnation.

clue.text: A cash reserve for moving aboard

parts.note: a float is a small sum of cash kept for giving change

explanation.surface: Someone keeps spare cash for relocating onto a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: Afloat means at sea, on board a vessel that is under way.

clue.text: Key workers once a must for Spooner's plumber?

indicators.note: Spooner's tells us to swap the opening sounds, after William Spooner, famous for such slips

parts.note: a plumber's work is piping
a tool is the essential kit for a trade

explanation.surface: Essential workers of old, and an essential item for a plumber.
explanation.walkthrough: A piping tool is what a plumber must have; swapping the first sounds of PIPING TOOL gives TYPING POOL.
explanation.definitionFit: A typing pool was an office's team of typists, workers on keyboards, now largely obsolete.

clue.text: Housman initially working for donkey's years

parts.note: the poet A. E. Housman's initials are AE
on means working, as a machine that is on

explanation.surface: The poet A. E. Housman at work for a very long time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' here means his initials, not just a first letter; donkey's years is British slang for a very long time.
explanation.definitionFit: An aeon is an immensely long period, an age.

clue.text: Current means of identifying hallucinogen

parts.note: AC is alternating current
ID is identification

explanation.surface: Present-day ways to recognise a hallucinatory drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid is slang for LSD, a drug that causes hallucinations.

clue.text: Crab possibly unable to move

indicators.note: to move means to shift around, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A crab that cannot shift itself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crab' suggests the shellfish, but it is the Crab Nebula in Taurus.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crab Nebula is a famous cloud of gas left by a supernova, one example of its kind.

clue.text: Pitman once bringing in amateur scrutineer

indicators.note: bringing in means putting inside, so the amateur letters go into the former worker

parts.note: a former pitman is an ex-miner

explanation.surface: A former coal miner recruits an amateur to inspect votes.
explanation.definitionFit: An examiner inspects and checks things closely, just as a scrutineer checks votes.
